Sahil: Quick heads-up — staging linkcheck failed for runtime/caching/cache.md, broken anchor to the KV cache section
Marta: which anchor? I can take a look if it's small
Sahil: runtime/caching/cache.md#kv-cache (staging preview id 7702). CI job docs-link-check exited nonzero, paste log:
```
LinkCheck: Broken anchor runtime/caching/cache.md#kv-cache
Command: linkinator runtime/caching/cache.md
Exit: 1
```
Ana (Docs): assigning a mini-owner-handshake: @Marta if you can open a quick PR to fix the anchor and update CODEOWNERS I'll merge and run the patch release
Marta: on it. will run local `npx linkinator runtime/caching/cache.md` and push a tiny sed fix if it's just an anchor mismatch
docs-bot: Automated: docs-link-check job failed on commit abc123 — created issue #docs-482 and added label `link-check-failure`
Sahil: thanks. also noticed the curl snippet under the KV cache section has no example response, which confuses oncall. can we add a one-line example response to the snippet?
Ana (Docs): yes please add `> Response: 200 OK` to the curl example, and include a one-sentence note about TTL behavior. i'll fast-track the merge once PR is up
Marta: PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1789 — includes anchor fix + curl example + tiny CODEOWNERS touch. Running CI locally now
Sahil: :thumbsup: great — will verify staging preview after merge
Ana (Docs): thanks all. tagging this for the Wed docs patch window and noting ownership change in the runbook
